resources.string: * Applies the next time the game starts.
A controller is connected, so touch controls hide on their own. Tick this to use both.
Size of the touch controls and the CTRL button: %1$d%%
Opacity of the touch controls and the CTRL button: %1$d%%
Slides into a small tab when not in use
Removed 30 s after the game starts (then Back opens these settings)
Cutscenes stay at 30 fps. Smoother 60 uses the 120 Hz screen mode: a late frame shows after 25 ms instead of 33 ms.
Frame rate and a frame time graph on screen.
The last start at 40 fps did not get going; back to 30 fps.
The 3D world is drawn at this size; menus and HUD stay sharp at 720p. 1080p is scaled down to 720p, which smooths edges rather than adding detail.
On screens wider than 16:9 the 3D world fills the whole screen, with more to see at the sides; menus and HUD stay in the middle, movies keep their 16:9. More pixels to draw: a little slower.
No black bars on phones wider than 16:9; the picture is stretched sideways. Movies keep their shape.
Schemata in battle (tap to switch), the map in the field, artwork in cutscenes.
A save made with a cheat on keeps its effects.
Records statistics for bug reports. Slight extra load.
Only if something looks wrong. Slower; shaders rebuild once.

This saves the game logs in your Download folder and opens a GitHub issue form with the game version, your phone, GPU and settings filled in. Describe the problem there and attach the logs file. You need a GitHub account; the game keeps running in the background.
Debug logging is off for this run, so the logs say little. For a better report, turn it on, restart the game, make the problem happen, then report it.
Logs saved in Download as %1$s. Attach that file to the issue.
No web browser found. Open %1$s on another device and attach %2$s.
Attach %1$s (the logs file the game just saved) here:
Save logs for a bug report …
Logs saved as %1$s. Attach that file to your bug report.
This device has no file picker to save the logs with.
For phones whose picture is wrong or whose game stops with a GPU error (for example the Adreno 600 series). Try one option at a time, with Debug logging on, and save the logs after each try.
The faster copies between render targets and textures.
Plainer shader code. Shaders rebuild once (several minutes).
Builds each GPU pipeline in one piece. New effects take longer to appear.
Turnip image compression off * (Turnip drivers only)
Progress since the game last saved is lost. To be safe, save in the game\'s main menu first, then exit here.
Settings marked * apply when the game starts. Restarting now loses progress since the last save.

Copies of your saves (every slot) in a folder you choose, outside the app, so uninstalling the game does not delete them. A copy is made when the game has saved, at most every 10 minutes. The latest 10 and one for each of the last 7 days played are kept, up to 64 MB in all (the latest 3 always).
Choose or create a folder, for example Documents/LR saves.
The app can no longer open this folder. Choose it again.
No backups in this folder yet.
The game has no saves yet.
This device has no folder picker.
Save backups are off. The backups stay in the folder.
Nothing to back up: the game has no saves yet.
The game was saving. Try again in a moment.
The game restarts with the saves from %1$s, all slots together. Your current saves are moved aside, not deleted. Progress since the last save is lost.
The backup replaces your saves the next time the game starts.
A backup replaces your saves the next time the game starts.
The newest is from %1$s. Restore it?
The newest is from %1$s. Restore it? If not, your current saves stay as they are and are backed up here too.
Saves restored from the backup of %1$s.
The save backup could not be restored (details in the log).
